assets.purpose: Focused lesson visual: Understanding PHP's Type System
assets.alt_text: Raw values are validated at boundaries, normalized, and then passed to typed application logic.
assets.caption: Prefer explicit contracts

assets.purpose: Focused lesson visual: The match Expression

assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf educational diagram generated for this PHP course.

assets.purpose: Focused lesson visual: Transforming Arrays
assets.alt_text: A collection can be mapped, filtered, and reduced into the result the application needs.
assets.caption: Transform intentionally
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf educational diagram generated for this PHP course.

assets.purpose: Focused lesson visual: Inheritance
assets.alt_text: Objects group state and behavior; interfaces define contracts and composition connects collaborators.
assets.caption: Prefer clear object boundaries
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf educational diagram generated for this PHP course.

assets.purpose: Focused lesson visual: try, catch, and finally
assets.alt_text: A failure is thrown, handled at an appropriate boundary, logged safely, and converted to a useful outcome.
assets.caption: Keep diagnostics separate from user output
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf educational diagram generated for this PHP course.

assets.purpose: Focused lesson visual: Sanitization, Validation, and Escaping
assets.alt_text: Validate incoming data against rules, then escape data for the exact output context.
assets.caption: Validation and encoding solve different problems
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf educational diagram generated for this PHP course.

assets.purpose: Focused lesson visual: Building a Login Workflow
assets.alt_text: Credentials are verified, session state is renewed, and authorization checks each protected resource.
assets.caption: Authentication is not authorization
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf educational diagram generated for this PHP course.

assets.purpose: Focused lesson visual: Prepared Statements
assets.alt_text: SQL structure is prepared independently from user-controlled values that are bound as parameters.
assets.caption: Never concatenate untrusted values into SQL
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf educational diagram generated for this PHP course.

assets.purpose: Focused lesson visual: Webhooks
assets.alt_text: Verify the sender, validate the payload, record a unique event identifier, and process each event once.
assets.caption: Duplicates and retries are expected
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf educational diagram generated for this PHP course.

assets.purpose: Focused lesson visual: PSR-4 Autoloading
assets.alt_text: A namespace prefix maps to a source directory and subsequent namespace segments map to subdirectories.
assets.caption: Keep namespace and path casing aligned
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf educational diagram generated for this PHP course.

assets.purpose: Focused lesson visual: Model-View-Controller
assets.alt_text: Routing selects a controller; application services implement rules; repositories handle persistence; a response is returned.
assets.caption: Separate HTTP, domain rules, and persistence
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf educational diagram generated for this PHP course.

assets.purpose: Focused lesson visual: Fundamentals of Software Testing
assets.alt_text: Small unit tests, integration tests, static analysis, and style checks provide different evidence.
assets.caption: No single check proves quality
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf educational diagram generated for this PHP course.

assets.purpose: Focused lesson visual: Performance Optimization Workflow
assets.alt_text: Define a target, profile representative traffic, make a narrow change, and measure for regressions.
assets.caption: Collect evidence before changing code
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf educational diagram generated for this PHP course.

assets.purpose: Focused lesson visual: Database Deployment and Migrations
assets.alt_text: Dependencies, tests, schema migrations, deployment, health checks, and rollback planning are coordinated.
